fusions.name: Reaping Hook
fusions.desc: A curved cut that deals 30 damage, is always a critical hit and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Hooked Fang
fusions.desc: Throws a hooked fang that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, and you heal for 25% of the damage dealt. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Gathered Harvest
fusions.desc: Restores 18 health to you. Its healing rises +8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max +40%).

fusions.name: Bent Grass
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 8%. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second.
